title: How do I share my contact info with a neighbour?

contentBody.question: How do I share my contact info with a neighbour?
contentBody.answer:
Your email, phone, and address stay private until you choose to share them. Sharing goes one way: it lets the neighbour you shared with start a conversation with you, and you can reply. To message them first, they need to share with you too.

In a response or conversation, tap Share Contact Info and tick exactly what you want to share: Email, Phone, or Address. You will see the details before they are sent. You can also turn on Auto-Share Contact Info when you create an ask or offer so it is shared automatically with whoever responds.

You can stop sharing at any time. FIMBY will hide your details and close that conversation, though details already emailed or saved by the other person cannot be taken back. Sharing again starts fresh, with a new conversation.

See who you are connected with under My Contacts.
